profile.headline: Software Engineer Lead Consultant

positions.title: Software Engineer Lead Consultant
positions.description:
- Lead architecture, design, and delivery of multiple enterprise applications spanning Java/Spring Boot, React, and AI powered solutions using agile development practices.
- Conduct technical discovery and POCs to evaluate emerging technologies.
- Designed a reusable digital factory pattern for AI driven digital workers, improving scalability and accelerating development.
- Partner with engineering and product teams to solution complex business problems, define technical roadmaps, and groom deliverables.
- Mentor developers through technical reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer Senior Consultant II
positions.description:
• Lead design and development for a tool to manage coverage exclusions
• Integrated Kafka messages with Fabric Event House
• Prioritize, plan and generate stories for sprints based on business requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer-Sr Cons I
positions.description:
• Prioritize, plan and generate stories for sprints based on business requirements.
• Perform peer code reviews and provide mentorship.
• Develop Rest APIs and UI using Java Spring boot and React.
• Maintain Jenkins build and deployment.

positions.title: Service Engineer-Sr Cons I
positions.description:
• Develop Rest APIs and UI for the application using Java Spring boot and React
• Performed POC and integration of identifying and onboarding products to the application
• Understand business requirements to design and implement features
• Perform peer code reviews and responsible for onboarding and peer mentoring
• Manage vault updates for third party API integrations
• Maintain Jenkins build and deployment
• Participate in prioritization and sprint planning

positions.title: Application Developer Cons II
positions.description:
• Responsible for supporting backend code for Rest APIs used by internal clients
• Analyze issues reported from 2nd level triage then analyze code and take it to closure
• Analyzing defect root cause and providing code fix in Java and write JUnit tests
• Provide hot fix changes during onshore hours
• Provide bi-monthly Sunday release support
• Participate in release notes reviews to ensure correct jars are promoted and smoke tested
• Work across the shores with different clients to provide defect fixes
• Analyze 4xx and 5xx errors in production using Dynatrace and provide code fix
• Run exception reports in Splunk and track newly introduced errors

positions.title: Application Developer Cons I
positions.description:
• Property production support team
• Analyze code to find defect root cause and provide code fix
• Write JUnit tests and Unit Test Plan documents
• Work with Restful services and API using Soap UI for Alliance 2.0 defects
• Investigate regression defects and complete release validation
• Worked on POC for IMB WAS 9.0 server migration
• Trace through Dynatrace for 4xx and 5xx errors in production and provide code fix

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
• Sign up to assist 5 days in a year
• Assist middle school and high school girls with projects in Ruby, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• Lead warm up activities for the session

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Full stack developer 
• Used TDD technique and pair programing in ‘Service & Repairs’ team project
• Used JavaScript, Angular JS, Handlebar, JDBC, JMS, Rest Client, GitHub, Jasmine, Chai

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
•	Updated and maintained department website using CMS Adobe Cq5
•	Collaborated in a dashboard website project that displayed tables and graphs of employee’s and    city’s work progress
•	Worked on dashboard’s front-end using CSS, HTML, JavaScript

company.name: City of Chicago Department of Buildings

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Worked with Objective-C and X-Code to create a Tap N’ Select iOS iPad App
• Compared the app performance with a Drag N’ Drop App developed by a fellow student
